name: blok_read
description: Read the document as a tree of blocks with ids, types and text. Read before you edit, and again after a STALE error.

name: blok_describe
description: Look up what you can do. With no arguments it lists tools and commands. Pass { tool } or { command } to get the argument schema.

name: blok_execute
description: Run a batch of commands. Either all of them land or none do. Use block ids from blok_read. To add several text blocks at once (headings, paragraphs, lists, code), use one markdown.insert. Call blok_describe for a command's arguments. Its result lists the changed blocks with their data as they now read, so you can check your work without blok_read.
